Rotate the signing key

Spec · 2026-08-14 · status: draft · owner: nitin

TL;DR

Dual-publish both keys for one token lifetime (14 days), cut signing to the new key, then retire the old one.

1 · Overview

Design is settled in spec a91f0c2b44. This is the build plan only. The constraint that shapes every stage: a token signed with the old key must stay verifiable until it expires, so the two keys overlap for a full 14-day lifetime.

2 · Implementation plan

  1. Stage 1 · Publish both keys

    todo
    • Serve both keys from the JWKS endpoint, new key first.verify: the endpoint returns two keys and a client picks by kid
    • Verify against either key.verify: tokens signed with both keys validate

    Verifiable output: a JWKS response with two entries

  2. Stage 2 · Cut over and retire

    todo
    • Sign with the new key.verify: a fresh token carries the new kid
    • Drop the old key 14 days after cutover.verify: JWKS returns one key; old tokens are rejected

    Verifiable output: a single-key JWKS response
